info.description: Agent Wormhole is a security layer for AI agents that transact with money. The project addresses a specific attack surface: AI agents read text (token metadata, tool descriptions, web pages, messages from other agents) and act on it, which allows hidden instructions in that text to manipulate an agent's behavior. Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.

Goldstein (GLDSTN) is the token of Goldstein Group, an on-chain investment firm on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). The firm’s product is the G-fund: a token that holds underlying assets and can be redeemed for a share of those assets. Described fund types include a dollar savings token (gUSDG), leveraged long and short tokens such as gETH3x and gETH3xShort that borrow on Morpho markets and are rebalanced by a keeper, and basket tokens managed under published mandates. The firm is organized around 2,520 membership seats issued as NFTs. Seat holders can issue funds and receive a share of fees.

WTH (What the Hook?) is a live Uniswap v4 swap rebate hook deployed on Robinhood Chain that internalizes cross-pool arbitrage profit and redistributes it to the traders and liquidity providers who created the opportunity — rather than allowing external bots to extract it. When a swap creates a price gap between connected pools, WTH's on-chain hook detects, captures, and settles the correction within the same transaction. Realized profit is split automatically: traders receive rebates on their trades, and liquidity providers earn a larger share streamed directly into connected pools.

Fables is a dynamic-fee ve(3,3) DEX built on Uniswap v4 and live on Robinhood Chain. At TGE, $PROLOGUE will redeem for the governance token at a fixed ratio. Every Fable starts somewhere. This is only the Prologue.
Hold $ORBIO, earn OpenRouter credits. Half of trading fees are converted into inference credits and paid to holders, in dollars.

Robinhood GLD is a tokenized representation of SPDR Gold Shares (GLD) common stock, issued on Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's own blockchain built to bring tokenized real-world assets on-chain. Each token is designed to track the price of the underlying GLD share, giving holders on-chain price exposure to SPDR Gold Shares's stock. The token is freely transferable and composable across the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. Somebody automated the desk. The analysts went home, the lights stayed on, and the only thing still sitting at the terminal is a shiba in a visor with a GPU in his mouth. He does not sleep. He does not blink. He does not sell. Artificial Doge is what is left when the machines take the seat and the dog takes the machine.
